claims.explanation: Arcyriaflavin A is a CDK4/cyclin D1 inhibitor, so sensitivity is expected in lines with intact CDK4/CCND1 signaling and dependence on this pathway. The most consistent genomic feature among sensitive lines is TP53 mutation, which may impair DNA damage-induced apoptosis and enhance dependence on CDK4 for survival. Conversely, protective features include CDKN2A mutation (which can disrupt CDK4 inhibition and reduce drug efficacy) and BRAF mutation (which may drive proliferation through MAPK independently of CDK4).
